checks.run:
import json, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.gauntlet import admit_gauntlet, compile_gauntlet_proposal, run_gauntlet, verify_survival_card, write_gauntlet_proposal
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    e2e = {"schema": "factory.e2e_proof_manifest.v1", "id": "smoke-case", "approval": {"state": "approved", "approved_by": "smoke-owner"}, "working_directory": ".", "timeout_seconds": 10, "network_egress": "not_granted", "positive": {"argv": [sys.executable, "-c", "from pathlib import Path; Path('proof.txt').write_text('ok')"]}, "negative": {"argv": [sys.executable, "-c", "import sys; sys.exit(1)"]}, "artifact_paths": ["proof.txt"]}
    reality = {"schema": "factory.reality-check-manifest.v1", "id": "smoke-promise", "approval": {"state": "approved", "approved_by": "smoke-owner"}, "behavior": {"promise": "Only a manager can approve.", "happy_path": "A manager approval is recorded.", "failure_case": "A non-manager approval is rejected."}, "intent_assertions": [{"id": "manager-approved", "statement": "Manager approval is recorded.", "evidence": "positive"}, {"id": "non-manager-blocked", "statement": "Non-manager approval is rejected.", "evidence": "negative"}], "e2e_manifest": "case.e2e.json"}
    source = {"schema": "factory.gauntlet-source.v1", "id": "smoke-gauntlet", "promises": [{"id": "approval", "statement": "Only a manager can approve.", "reality_manifest": "promise.reality.json", "sabotage_cases": [{"id": "wrong-role", "risk_tag": "authorization", "summary": "A non-manager must be rejected.", "e2e_manifest": "case.e2e.json"}]}]}
    (root / "case.e2e.json").write_text(json.dumps(e2e), encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "promise.reality.json").write_text(json.dumps(reality), encoding="utf-8")
    source_path = root / "gauntlet.json"
    source_path.write_text(json.dumps(source), encoding="utf-8")
    proposal = write_gauntlet_proposal(root, compile_gauntlet_proposal(root, source_path))
    admission = Path(admit_gauntlet(root, proposal, approved_by="smoke-owner", rationale="Run declared local proof.", confirmation="ADMIT smoke-gauntlet")["path"])
    result = run_gauntlet(root, proposal, admission)
    assert result["card"]["marker"] == "GAUNTLET_SURVIVED"
    assert verify_survival_card(Path(result["path"]))["ok"] is True
print("GAUNTLET_SURVIVED")
